### Tool usage
*~2,500 tokens/session saved*
- `mcp__headroom__headroom_retrieve` requires `hash` arg; never call it empty. Take hash preceding compressed output.
- Pipeline review-finish: read `review.json`, `result.json`, `transcript.md`, `rv.err` in one parallel Read batch, write `.review/review-<n>-tasks.md` file via `bk.ps1`.
- Retrieval failed once with an empty call (`'hash' required property`). Copy the `hash=...` value from the nearest `[N items compressed ... Retrieve more: hash=...]` marker before calling.
